name: academic-research-skills
description: ChatGPT adaptation of Academic Research Skills with five ChatGPT-native workflows, mapped dependencies, transactional SQLite workflow orchestration, and an MCP v2.3.0 backend with reproducible SDK/Docker CI tests. HTTP transport uses a loopback-default Host/Origin allowlist; public deployment still requires OAuth 2.1 and TLS.

interface.shortDescription: Research, write, review, and screen academic literature
interface.longDescription: A human-in-the-loop academic research toolkit with five workflows: deep research, academic paper writing, manuscript review, end-to-end research pipeline, and systematic-review screening. Preserves source provenance and requires researcher verification.
